::: {.software-header}
::: {}
BIGr provides genomic and pedigree analysis functions designed for diploid and polyploid breeding programs. It also serves as a computational foundation for workflows exposed through BIGapp.

<div class="meta-row"><span class="pill">R package</span><span class="pill">Diploid + polyploid</span><span class="pill">CRAN</span></div>
:::
<div class="software-badge">BIGr</div>
:::

## Start here

```r
install.packages("BIGr")
library(BIGr)
```

[Documentation](https://breeding-insight.github.io/BIGr_documentation/){.btn-bi-primary}
[Source code](https://github.com/Breeding-Insight/BIGr){.btn-bi-secondary}
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=BIGr){.btn-bi-secondary}

## Good fit for

- Genotype processing and format conversion
- Diploid and polyploid genomic analyses
- Workflows that also feed BIGapp
